sentences.text: Tropical cyclones are classified by sustained wind.
A tropical depression has winds under thirty-four knots, a tropical storm thirty-four to sixty-three knots, and a hurricane sixty-four knots or more.
Category three and higher hurricanes, ninety-six knots and above, are called major hurricanes.
Atlantic hurricane season runs from June first through November thirtieth, with the peak from August through October.
The National Hurricane Center issues a watch when hurricane conditions are possible, usually within forty-eight hours, and a warning when they are expected, usually within thirty-six hours.
